Firebase cloud workspace

TRAVELOG · travelog-itinerary

Changes save automatically to Firebase. No email or password is needed.

This browser keeps its own cloud workspace. Export a backup before clearing browser data. New browsers start a separate workspace.

Firebase setup if access is denied

In Firebase Authentication, enable the Anonymous sign-in provider. The app will connect automatically. No email account is required.

Add the rules below to the existing rule blocks. Preserve existing TRAVELOG app rules. These additions restrict invoice data to its signed-in owner.

Firestore rules

// Add these matches inside your existing service cloud.firestore
// match /databases/{database}/documents block. Keep existing app rules.
match /invoiceStudioUsers/{uid}/workspaces/{workspaceId} {
  function owner() { return request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid; }
  function validWorkspace() {
    return request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['schemaVersion', 'payload', 'revision', 'updatedAt'])
      && request.resource.data.schemaVersion == 2
      && request.resource.data.payload is string
      && request.resource.data.payload.size() <= 900000
      && request.resource.data.revision is int
      && request.resource.data.updatedAt == request.time;
  }
  allow read: if owner();
  allow create: if owner() && validWorkspace() && request.resource.data.revision == 1;
  allow update: if owner() && validWorkspace()
    && request.resource.data.revision == resource.data.revision + 1;
  allow delete: if false;
}
match /invoiceStudioUsers/{uid}/counters/invoice {
  function owner() { return request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid; }
  function validCounter() {
    return request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['next'])
      && request.resource.data.next is int && request.resource.data.next >= 18;
  }
  allow read: if owner();
  allow create: if owner() && validCounter();
  allow update: if owner() && validCounter()
    && request.resource.data.next >= resource.data.next;
  allow delete: if false;
}

Cloud Storage rules

// Add inside your existing service firebase.storage
// match /b/{bucket}/o block. Keep existing app rules.
match /invoiceStudio/{uid}/backups/{filename} {
  allow read: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid;
  allow create: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid
    && request.resource.size < 20 * 1024 * 1024
    && request.resource.contentType == 'application/json';
  allow update, delete: if false;
}

Cloud backups use the configured travelog-itinerary.firebasestorage.app bucket. Cloud Storage must be enabled for this project. Internet access is required for cloud sync.
